about: Trending looks and voices (aicontent9). Every asset was made on this Mac by Gaziyav's own on-device tools; no real person's face or voice is used or imitated.

looks.source: local-faceswap.py --look <id> (shaders inside the face parser outline; no generative model) applied to the app's made-up faces public/faces/idol.jpg and public/faces/diva.jpg (made with the app's image generator)

voices.source: Qwen3-TTS 1.7B (Apache-2.0) speaking from the app's ready-voice recordings (Resources/voices: the model's built-in made-up speakers), then ffmpeg treatment (studio/server/voice-fx.ts)
voices.license: Apache-2.0 model output; samples are Gaziyav's own work
